tests.title: parses declared names, aliases, shorthand order, numeric modes and booleans into frozen steps
deinterleaves, interleaves and swaps rows into owned tight planes from padded input without mutating it
keeps the native packed-alpha quirk: one packed plane runs as luma then alpha, so alpha settings win
refuses odd processed plane heights on every path before any output
rejects budgets, malformed strides, plane counts, time bases and cancellation explicitly
matches native linear il for all 14 formats, every mode triple and every swap combination at even plane heights
matches native il CLI rawvideo and framecrc through -vf and -filter_complex with timing scopes
matches native il graphs through replayed streams frame by frame
matches native il through the timed backend actor and pull schedulers in rawvideo and framecrc
matches native il option aliases, shorthand and numeric forms, and refuses what native refuses
refuses odd processed plane heights on every flagged path before opening outputs, where native output is pool dependent

details.what: linear rawvideo bytes, all 14 formats x 3 sizes x 27 mode triples x 8 swap combinations (42 native runs, split into 216 outputs each)
CLI -vf and -filter_complex rawvideo and framecrc bytes, including timing scopes and 4 -cpuflags 0 conversions
replay stream rawvideo bytes and timestamps
timed backend activation (actor) and pull (timed) rawvideo and framecrc bytes

unsupported: odd processed plane heights (refused: native output is buffer-pool dependent)
expression-valued modes such as l=1.5 or l=i+0 (refused; native evaluates them)
